meta.title: Team Player Test
meta.description: A detailed 500-question reflection across 20 dimensions of effective teamwork.

levels.label: Exceptional Team Player
levels.desc: You consistently strengthen shared goals, trust, coordination, inclusion, accountability, and team learning.

levels.label: Strong Team Player
levels.desc: Your teamwork habits are effective across most dimensions, with a few opportunities for greater consistency or influence.

levels.label: Developing Team Player
levels.desc: You contribute several valuable team habits, though communication, follow-through, conflict, or shared ownership may vary.

levels.label: Emerging Team Contributor
levels.desc: Some foundations are present, while clearer coordination, listening, reliability, and feedback could strengthen your contribution.

levels.label: Inconsistent Teamwork Habits
levels.desc: Your teamwork may become isolated, reactive, or unclear. Start with communication, reliability, respect, and shared goals.

levels.label: Teamwork Foundations Needed
levels.desc: Current habits may limit coordination and trust. Practising one dimension at a time can build stronger team contribution.
